shortDescription: Manage Splunk Enterprise Security investigation types

options.name: api_app
options.description: The app portion of the Splunk API path for the incident types endpoint. Override this if your environment uses a different app name.

options.name: api_namespace
options.description: The namespace portion of the Splunk API path. Override this if your environment uses a different namespace.

options.name: api_user
options.description: The user portion of the Splunk API path. Override this if your environment requires a different user context.

options.name: description
options.description: The description of the investigation type.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the investigation type. This is the unique identifier and is always required. The name cannot be changed after creation.

options.name: response_plan_ids
options.description: List of response plan tempalte UUIDs to associate with this investigation type. Use the C(splunk_response_plan_info) module to get response plan template IDs. If not specified or empty, no response plans will be associated. B(Note:) This is declarative - only the IDs listed here will be associated. Any existing associations not in this list will be removed.
